_help.what_is_this: CENTCOM campaign template (name-based). Units are matched by name against the Google Sheet roster CSV.
how_unit_matching_works: Every unit reference in this file is a unitName string.
The app should normalize names (trim, collapse spaces, lowercase) before matching.
If a unit is renamed in the sheet, update it here too.
how_backend_linking_works: Each unit name becomes a Backend Roster filter link (e.g. /backend-roster?unit=77th%20Air%20Wing).
BackendRosterView should read query.unit and filter the roster table by unit name.
